status: PROPOSAL (A-446 measurement) - settings for source-structure evidence about a table that may continue on the next page; evidence for a human reviewer, not used by the pipeline, never joins anything

line_tol_rel_height.unit: fraction of the median word height; words whose vertical centres differ by at most this belong to one text line

bbox_slack_pt.unit: pt; slack when deciding whether a word or a drawn segment lies inside / on the edge of a table box

min_words.unit: words; the first body line of the later table must have at least this many words to count as a repeated header

x_tol_rel.unit: fraction of the wider table; the repeated line must start at the same x position within this tolerance

min_series_lines.unit: lines; a numbering series (ranges 'a-b' or an integer counter in the first column) must be seen on at least this many lines of a table to be used

range_tolerance.unit: value units; last range end of the first table must equal first range start of the next table within this tolerance

counter_step.unit: integer; first counter value of the next table minus last value of the first table

counter_column_frac.unit: fraction of table width; an integer counts as a first-column counter only if it starts within this distance of the table left edge

min_rule_len_frac.unit: fraction of table height; a vertical drawn segment at least this long is a column rule

rule_x_tol_rel.unit: fraction of the wider table; column rule x positions of the two tables must agree within this tolerance

cluster_tol_pt.unit: pt; vertical segments closer than this are one rule

min_rule_width_frac.unit: fraction of table width; a horizontal drawn segment at least this wide on the table edge is a closed border

continued_pattern.unit: case-insensitive regex searched in the words of the table box and in the strip of strip_frac page height above / below it

pattern.unit: case-insensitive regex on the page text; counters whose total equals the PDF page count are the running page footer and are ignored

decision.note: STRUCTURE_SUPPORTS_CONTINUATION needs a layout match (equal column rules) AND a continuity signal (numbering continuous, or an explicit 'continued' marker, or both borders open across the break) AND, unless a marker is present, a repeated header. A repeated header alone (same report title on different days) is never enough. STRUCTURE_CONFLICT: columns differ or numbering restarts. Otherwise UNDETERMINED. Closed borders on both sides are reported as a caveat (each page has its own frame).
